title: Respond to cached or denied access
responsibility: Makes the shown project read-only when it goes offline and removes shared project content when access is denied.

inputs.name: offlineCapabilities.source
inputs.description: The capability source, local or github, that offlineCapabilities keeps unchanged in its result. markOffline passes the shown project's current source when the view first enters offline mode, and nothing checks the value against those two options.

inputs.name: forgetShared.workspace
inputs.description: The live workspace store, changed in place: its project list, pending navigation and shown-project state may be altered. A shown project whose capabilities source is github is cleared only when the event names it or names $projects.

inputs.name: forgetShared.projectId
inputs.description: The identity of the denied project, or the reserved value $projects for the whole session. $projects removes every shared project from the list, a named project leaves the list as it is, and either form can invalidate a pending target not listed as local and clear the shown GitHub-backed project when it matches the event.

inputs.name: forgetShared.notice
inputs.description: The message stored as workspace.error when the shown GitHub-backed project is cleared. cacheStatus passes deniedNotice for every denied event, but the message is stored only when that project is cleared.
examples: Access to this shared project ended. Connect again or ask its owner.

inputs.name: cacheStatus.workspace
inputs.description: The live workspace store that cacheStatus updates in place. It can change for a denied event, which applies the forgetShared rules, and for an offline event that names the shown project while a snapshot is shown; fresh events and offline events for other projects leave it unchanged.

inputs.name: cacheStatus.event
inputs.description: A cache event with a projectId, a status of fresh, offline or denied, and an optional cachedAt time that only offline events use. An offline event acts only when it names the shown project, a denied event removes affected shared content, and a fresh event changes nothing.

inputs.name: offlineView.snapshot
inputs.description: The project snapshot to inspect, of which only the optional cache field matters: a snapshot without cache is not cached. It counts as cached when cache.status is 'offline' or cache.readOnly is true.

outputs.name: everyProject
outputs.description: The reserved project id $projects, used for events about the whole session or project discovery rather than one project. forgetShared treats it as the whole session, so it removes every shared project from the list.

outputs.name: deniedNotice
outputs.description: The exact text stored as the workspace error when a denied event clears the shown GitHub-backed project. cacheStatus passes it for every denied event, but it is stored only when that project is cleared.
examples: Access to this shared project ended. Connect again or ask its owner.

outputs.name: offlineNotice
outputs.description: The exact reason text that offlineCapabilities sets on an offline view's capabilities. It is a fixed string, so every offline view carries the same reason.
examples: Offline cached view. Comments and changes need a connection.

outputs.name: offlineCapabilities
outputs.description: The capabilities of an offline view: comments, agents, planning and approval are false, the supplied source is kept, and reason is the offline notice. markOffline assigns them only when the view first enters offline mode, whereas forgetShared assigns closedCapabilities, which has no reason.

examples.reason: Offline cached view. Comments and changes need a connection.
Offline cached view. Comments and changes need a connection.

outputs.name: offlineView
outputs.description: The cached-view information for a snapshot: an object whose cachedAt is the time the cached copy was saved, or null when the cache records none. The whole value is null when the snapshot is neither offline nor read-only.

outputs.name: forgetShared
outputs.description: No value is returned; the workspace is changed in place. A whole-session denial removes shared projects from the list; a pending target is invalidated when the denial names it or the whole session, unless it is listed as local; and a shown GitHub-backed project is cleared (no snapshot, entity or offline state, closed capabilities, notice as error) when the denial names it or the whole session, with a project-list refresh only for a single named project.

outputs.name: cacheStatus
outputs.description: No value is returned; the workspace is changed in place. A denied event applies the forgetShared rules, and an offline event for the shown project, while a snapshot is shown, marks that snapshot unwritable and records the cached time, setting offline capabilities only on first entry and updating existing cache metadata; fresh events and offline events for other projects change nothing.
